en.why_it_matters: Carr/Keys gives this Hillwood night a specific local identity: Paul Carr's tenor and Marshall Keys's alto meet at the seam between straight-ahead jazz and soul, with Keys rooted in Washington and Carr now leading Howard University's jazz ensemble. On the Lunar Lawn, the point is not venue prestige but a distinctly DMV saxophone conversation in a setting built for listening closely without turning the evening into a formal club date.
en.trip_verdict: If you already have a Hillwood ticket, arrive with time to settle in before the 6:30 Lunar Lawn set and let the gardens carry the early evening. If you do not, do not contort the night around unofficial access: Hillwood's official ticketing page currently shows the program sold out.
